reviews.reviewbody: A waste of time and disk space
After seeing the review above, I had to add my own. This is a specimen book and it has a wonderful assortment of graphics and frames.
The problem is that whoever scanned it did it in monochrome, not gray scale. So it looks very pixely.

reviews.reviewtitle: A note on the publication date.
reviews.reviewbody:
While the opening letter is dated May, 1885, and some of the typefaces were released. after that date, much of this book was published in 1878.

MS&J began to number each edition of its complete specimen books with their 11th in 1878. This is an 1885 reissue of that catalog. [Saxe] [Opening letter dated May, 1885] It contains specimens of some typefaces known to be released after 1878, such as [Dado and Ringlet](https://archive.org/details/cu31924032183760/page/n463/mode/2up?q=ringlet).
